disclosures.llmModel: openai/gpt-5.6-luna via OpenRouter OpenAI-compatible chat completions, temperature 0, Graphiti JSON-object fallback with schema in prompt
disclosures.embeddingModel: BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 through a local Graphiti EmbedderClient, 384 dimensions, CPU
disclosures.storage: Graphiti OSS with a fresh embedded FalkorDBLite graph per benchmark question
disclosures.writePolicy: Use Graphiti add_episode_bulk for every allowed event, preserving event-to-episode identity from the returned native episode objects; accepted-only by default and include tentative events only for an explicit tentative view
disclosures.retrievalPolicy: Graphiti basic hybrid edge search with question text, isolated group ID, fixture topK or 5, then flatten and deduplicate each ranked edge's native episode UUIDs into fixture event IDs
disclosures.providerCostBoundary: Graphiti entity/edge extraction calls are provider-charged and reported from OpenRouter-native response usage; embeddings, hybrid retrieval, and graph storage are local
notes: Graphiti telemetry is disabled and the embedded graph is deleted after each question.
Bulk ingestion is Graphiti's documented efficient multi-episode path; the timing still includes complete native formation, local embedding, storage, and retrieval.
Retrieval-only scoring: no separate answer reader is added, Datalog rules remain unsupported, and Graphiti facts are mapped back to their native source episodes rather than guessed from text.
A no-op cross-encoder is supplied because the basic RRF search path does not use cross-encoder reranking; this prevents an unmeasured extra provider client.
